title: TransMIL: Transformer based Correlated Multiple Instance Learning for Whole Slide Image Classification
study_context: Transformer-based correlated MIL for WSI classification.
population_or_data: CAMELYON16, TCGA-NSCLC, and TCGA-RCC benchmark tasks.
task: Weakly supervised binary and multiclass WSI classification.
method: Transformer MIL that models correlations among instances and incorporates morphological and spatial information.
main_findings: TransMIL explicitly models relationships among WSI instances and reported strong results on three cancer benchmarks.
limitations: The experiments are cancer benchmarks rather than cardiac allograft biopsies.
does_not_establish: The architecture paper does not establish superiority over simpler MIL pooling for this project's data size and endpoints.
relevance_to_project: Candidate comparator when testing whether inter-patch context adds value beyond attention pooling.
